address: Manhattan, New York, NY
note: Leave the LIC / UWS hotel by 7 AM. Uber to EWR to pick up the SUV. Wheels rolling on I-78 W by 8:15.
eat: Bagel and coffee before the tunnel.
see: Skyline in the rearview from the Lincoln Tunnel approach.

address: Clinton Station Diner, 2 Bank St, Clinton, NJ 08809
note: First flush stop. Walk the lot for five minutes before you sit down.
eat: Clinton Station Diner — real Jersey diner, sit at the counter.
see: Nothing scenic yet — this stop is for the legs.

address: Spelunker's, 116 South St, Front Royal, VA 22630
note: Fill the tank here. No fuel available inside Shenandoah NP in November.
eat: Spelunker's — cavern-themed burger + frozen custard.
see: Shenandoah River from the bridge on your way in.

address: Big Meadows Wayside, Skyline Drive mp 51, Shenandoah NP
note: Pit stop and horizon check. Ten minutes, then back on Skyline south.
eat: Thermos coffee refill only.
see: Open sky over the meadow. Deer at any hour.

address: Blackrock Summit Trailhead, Skyline Drive mp 84.8
note: 1.0 mi loop, 175 ft gain, ~45 min. Non-optional recovery flush.
eat: Snack in the day pack. Water — 1L minimum.
see: 360° stone-field summit. Four ridges deep.

address: Hotel Madison, 710 S Main St, Harrisonburg, VA 22801
highway: US-33 W · via Swift Run Gap
note: Hotel Madison is the pick. Alt: Blackburn Inn in Staunton (25 mi south).
eat: Jack Brown's Beer & Burger or Pale Fire Brewing.
see: Downtown Harrisonburg. Walkable.

address: Blue Ridge Parkway mp 0, Waynesboro, VA
note: Fuel and provisions before entering. No gas on the BRP itself.
eat: Coffee thermos filled at Shen Valley in Harrisonburg.
see: Blue Ridge Parkway mp 0 sign.

address: Peaks of Otter, BRP mp 86, Bedford, VA
note: BRP highlight. 30 min minimum, 1 hr if the light is good.
eat: Sharp Top Trail overlook lunch. Sandwich from the wayside store.
see: Abbott Lake reflection of Sharp Top.

address: Downtown Asheville, NC
note: Cut Mabry Mill for time. Drop off BRP near Buchanan, take I-81/I-40.
eat: Wicked Weed / Burial Beer / Cúrate / 12 Bones BBQ.
see: River Arts District (RAD) if you have daylight.

address: Newfound Gap Overlook, Great Smoky Mountains NP
note: Pivot moment: leaving the East. ~20 min stop.
eat: Nothing — no food service in the park corridor.
see: State line marker. Appalachian Trail crosses here.

address: Clingmans Dome Observation Tower, Great Smoky Mountains NP
note: Paved 0.5-mi climb. ~30 min round trip.
eat: Water only.
see: Highest point in the Smokies (6,643 ft). 360° tower view.

address: East Nashville or Germantown, Nashville, TN
note: Target East Nashville or Germantown. Book ahead — Wed nights are surprisingly busy.
eat: Prince's Hot Chicken (Nashville original) or Hattie B's.
see: East Nashville or Germantown. Skip lower Broadway.

address: National Civil Rights Museum, 450 Mulberry St, Memphis, TN 38103
note: 2.5 hr stop total: 90 min museum + 45 min lunch + walk.
eat: Central BBQ, 147 E Butler Ave — pulled pork plate.
see: National Civil Rights Museum at the Lorraine Motel. 90 min minimum.

address: I-40 corridor, Amarillo, TX
highway: I-40 W · through Little Rock, OKC
note: THE transit day. Over 11 hrs door to door. Arrive ~10 PM. Sleep hard.
eat: Late arrival — hotel bar or 24-hr taqueria off I-40.
see: The horizon flattening for hours. Sunset in Oklahoma.

address: Palo Duro Canyon State Park, 11450 State Hwy Park Rd 5, Canyon, TX 79015
note: Real 2-hour stop, not a drive-by. Cadillac Ranch cut.
eat: Nothing — provisions from Amarillo.
see: 'Grand Canyon of Texas.' Red rock, 800 ft deep.

address: Route 66, Tucumcari, NM 88401
note: Get off I-40, drive Tucumcari Blvd end to end, then back on the highway.
eat: Del's Restaurant — neon cow sign, real green chile.
see: Blue Swallow Motel neon at dusk.

address: BLM dispersed camping, west of Albuquerque, NM
note: First car-camping night. Elevation ~5,300 ft, near-freezing overnight.
eat: Green chile cheeseburger at Sadie's, 5400 Cutler Ave.
see: Sandia Peak turning pink at sunset.

address: Painted Desert Visitor Center, Petrified Forest NP, AZ
note: Enter north, exit south. 2 hours minimum inside the park.
eat: Cold breakfast from the cooler on the rim.
see: Painted Desert rim + Petrified Forest 28-mi scenic road.

address: Meteor Crater Natural Landmark, Winslow, AZ 86047
note: 20 min off I-40, ~45 min at the rim.
eat: Small deli inside the visitor center.
see: 0.7-mi-wide asteroid impact crater. 50,000 years old.

address: Mather Campground, Grand Canyon South Rim, AZ
note: Mather Campground — Sat Nov 7 = weekend, book EARLY.
eat: Camp stove: pasta + a can of chile. Or Bright Angel restaurant.
see: South Rim at sunset. Hopi Point or Yavapai Point.

address: Upper Antelope Canyon, Page, AZ 86040
note: The one time-locked booking of the trip. 8-10 AM slot for the beams.
eat: Coffee in Page — Big John's or Ravens Cafe.
see: Sandstone light beams. Navajo-guided only.

address: Horseshoe Bend Overlook, Page, AZ
note: 45 min stop. Then push west through Kanab to Zion.
eat: Post-tour lunch: State 48 Tavern or Bonkers in Page.
see: Colorado River in a perfect horseshoe, 1,000 ft below.

address: Watchman Campground, Zion NP, Springdale, UT
note: Two nights here (Sun + Mon). Watchman = walk-in campground with hot showers.
eat: Springdale: Oscar's Cafe (fish tacos) or MeMe's Cafe (crepes).
see: Watchman peak turning red at sunset from camp.

address: Valley of Fire State Park Visitor Center, Overton, NV
note: 1.5 hr stop before the LA push. Last true desert of the trip.
eat: Provisions from Springdale gas station or St. George.
see: Red sandstone spires. Fire Wave loop is 1.5 mi.

address: Santa Monica / Venice / Malibu, Los Angeles, CA
note: Book Santa Monica specifically — Wed morning is PCH north to Point Dume + El Matador.
eat: Gjelina in Venice or Bay Cities Deli in Santa Monica.
see: The Pacific. Stand there until the engine ticks cool.

address: Point Dume State Beach & Nature Preserve, 6800 Westward Beach Rd, Malibu, CA 90265
note: First real PCH stop, Wed ~9 AM. 45 min: cliff loop trail + optional 15 min down the stairs to sea level.
eat: Coffee at Malibu Farm Pier Cafe on the way out. Nothing at the point itself — bring water.
see: Cliffside overlook of the whale-migration channel. Gray whales southbound in November. Stairs down to the tide pools.

address: El Matador State Beach, 32350 Pacific Coast Hwy, Malibu, CA 90265
highway: PCH (CA-1) · 4 mi north of Point Dume
note: The Pacific recovery plunge, if the surf is calm: 3 min cold, 10 min in the sun, repeat twice. Cold water on marathon-tired quads.
eat: Neptune's Net (42505 PCH, 5 mi further north) — burger + fried shrimp if the mood strikes. Otherwise cooler snacks.
see: Sea stacks, sandstone arches, tide pools. The postcard-Malibu photograph.

address: Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)
highway: PCH S → I-10 E → I-405 S
note: Wed ~2 PM back at Santa Monica (wash car, gas, repack). Sleep SM. Thu Nov 12: leave hotel 10:30, rental drop 11:30, LAX 12:00, wheels up 15:00.
eat: Coffee at the gate. You made it.
see: The Pacific one more time out the window on takeoff.
